resources.memory_binding: Unchanged: no explicit membind; taskset CPU0-7 plus external NUMA page observation

config.runtime: vLLM0.11.2 fixed WiSP cap16 BF16 with common batched map; prefetch/dynamic off; one next prefill chunk action
config.holdout_scope: Exploratory action intervention on previously observed A=[4,5,6], B=[4,5,9]; not independent unseen workload.

first_action_payload.boundary: Host counter deltas for first mixed and next branch call times fixed per-expert tensor bytes; read tax separate; no pure memcpy or wire claim

config.total_payload: Sum final_worker pager_layers weight_copy_payload_bytes after measurement counter reset; complete episode includes preaction prefix; bytes are copied tensor bytes, not PCIe wire bytes
config.question: After one common chunk16, does incoming document change the full-request benefit/cost of only the next chunk8/16/32, relative to next16?
config.reference_rule: All cells use common incumbent prefix; within each document, six prebranch request histories, scheduler/KV metadata and pager slot/LRU states must hash identically. No K/V tensor byte-equality claim.
config.retention: Keep every episode including first; stop on first failure; all raw remote; safe numeric/hash export only
config.measurement_control: Same LLM/CUDA context/pinned-master/scratch/map/KV allocations, native schedule restored, drained KV queue sorted and pager state emptied before identical warmup; all control costs retained separately and excluded from episode by original measurement boundary; same tiny pinned map buffers/events in both arms; no profiler; map stats reset before measurement and final GPU map validation after wall receipt; actual expert bytes/LRU/output hashes compared; new single prebranch snapshot in every arm remains in episode wall; only selected next prefill chunk differs, later state regenerated
config.interpretation: One mixed chunk16, then exactly one next8/16/32, then static16 through completion. Independent natural state evolution. No SLO or scheduler GO.
config.correction: ensure_calls counts expert subgroups; verify 16 layer entries, positive subgroup calls and nonnegative deltas, not subgroup count==16
config.workload_reconstruction: Hash-check both existing remote inputs; old retains its three rows; new uses old rows 0,1 plus source-new row 2. Serialize JSON indent=2 with trailing newline, and verify each target workload SHA. Input tokens are not uploaded.

design.primary: Document by action interaction in incumbent max-ITL versus cohort wall tradeoff; within each block compute (new action-new16)-(old action-old16).
design.negative_control: next16 performs the same scheduler actions as static16; its two episodes per document describe repeat drift, not a population noise bound.
design.replication_boundary: Two randomized six-cell blocks, n=2 per doc/action; no independent within-block repeats, no significance or guaranteed noise floor.
design.decision: Repeated document-specific interaction plus a changed nondominated action supports a candidate for fresh independent workload. Pure common chunk-size tradeoff or ordinary latency explanation gives no expert-feedback residual; ambiguous drift prompts targeted repeat, never family NO-GO.
design.prebranch_capture: Existing logical scheduler/KV block metadata, request token histories and pager state; single snapshot is common to all arms, included in wall and separately timed; no tensor snapshot.

frozen_prediction.recent_mixed: Predicted branch duration = first completed mixed duration * curve_s[next_chunk] / curve_s[16].
frozen_prediction.online_visibility: Predictions saved before next action; first mixed counter/duration only. No later calls or outcomes.
frozen_prediction.prediction_use: Diagnostic of action costs, not post-hoc selection of best arm; no expert predictor added.
